test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All villas are buildings.

Some buildings are apartments.

Conclusions:

(I) All buildings are villas.

(II) Some villas are not apartments.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Statements:

All villas are buildings.

Some buildings are apartments.

Possible venn diagram is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34c52f7072df5973cfd507e12df064222f40622ebb810ba5717d57f49b84e24a.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All buildings are villas.→ **Not follow **(As all villas are buildings but we can't say that the all buildings are villas.)

(II) Some villas are not apartments. → **Not follow **(As all villas are buildings, then some villas are not apartments is not possible.)

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
